Gutter Services in Columbus, OH, Fast Repairs, Installation, and Replacement

Water that does not drain away from your home causes real damage. It soaks into your foundation walls, erodes landscaping, and can flood your basement. A working gutter system is the first line of defense against all of it. Coldstream Exteriors helps Columbus homeowners solve gutter problems the right way, with professional service backed by honest pricing and quality materials.
Call Coldstream Exteriors at (614) 812-0811 today to schedule gutter services in Columbus, OH.
Your local gutter experts in Columbus

Central Ohio weather is hard on gutters. Heavy spring rains, summer storms, ice buildup in winter, and falling leaves in autumn all wear down your gutter system over time. When gutters fail, water runs down your siding, pools around your foundation, and seeps into places it should never reach.

Hiring a professional gutter contractor matters because the fit, pitch, and placement of every section affect how well the system performs. A gutter that is even slightly off-pitch will hold standing water. That leads to rust, sagging, and overflow. Coldstream Exteriors measures and installs each run to match the specific dimensions of your roofline. We use straightforward pricing with no hidden fees, so you know what you are paying before work begins.

Our crew also inspects your soffit and fascia during every gutter project. Rotted fascia boards compromise even a brand-new gutter system. We catch those problems early and fix them so your investment lasts.
What to expect during your gutter service
Every gutter project with Coldstream Exteriors follows a clear process. Here is what happens from the first call to the final walkthrough.
Inspection and assessment. We examine your current gutter system, fascia boards, and downspout layout. We check for sagging, rust, leaks, and improper pitch.
Recommendation. Based on what we find, we recommend repair, gutter replacement , or a full gutter installation . We explain why and provide a written estimate.
Material selection. We help you choose the right gutter profile, material, and size for your home. Most Columbus homes do well with 5-inch or 6-inch aluminum K-style gutters.
Installation. Our installers mount the system with proper slope, sealed joints, and secure hangers spaced to handle Ohio's heavy rainfall and snow loads.
Testing and cleanup. We flush the entire system with water to verify drainage. We clean up all debris and walk you through the finished work.
Our gutter services in Columbus, OH
Gutter installation : New gutter systems sized and pitched for your roofline. Includes hangers, end caps, and outlets.
Gutter replacement : Full removal of old gutters and installation of a new system. We inspect and repair fascia before mounting.
Seamless gutters : Custom-formed on site to fit your home with no seams along the run. Fewer joints means fewer leaks.
Gutter guards : Leaf and debris protection that keeps your gutters flowing without constant cleaning.
Downspouts : Proper downspout placement and extensions that move water well away from your foundation.
Gutter repair: Fixing leaks, reattaching loose sections, resealing joints, and correcting pitch on existing systems.
Why Columbus homeowners trust Coldstream Exteriors

Coldstream Exteriors is a locally operated exterior contractor based out of Galloway, OH. We handle gutters alongside residential roofing , siding , and window replacement . That means we see the full picture of your home's exterior, not just one piece of it.

Our crews show up on time, explain the scope of work before starting, and leave the job site clean. We stand behind our work with written warranties and responsive follow-up. When you need Gutter Services in Columbus, OH , you want a contractor who treats your home the way they would treat their own.
Common gutter problems we fix
Overflowing gutters during rain. This usually means a clog, undersized gutters, or incorrect pitch. We clear blockages and correct the slope so water moves toward the downspout.
Gutters pulling away from the house. Failed hangers or rotted fascia boards are the most common causes. We replace the fascia and reinstall with heavy-duty brackets.
Standing water in gutter channels. Sections with no slope hold water. That leads to rust, mosquito breeding, and added weight that causes more sagging.
Water stains on siding or foundation. This points to a leak at a seam or a missing downspout extension. We seal the joint or add extensions to redirect water.
Ice dams forming along the roofline. Poor attic ventilation and clogged gutters trap melting snow. We clear the system and can install gutter guards to reduce future buildup.
Basement moisture after storms. When downspouts dump water too close to the foundation, it seeps through basement walls. We extend downspouts and regrade drainage paths.

Sometimes repairs make sense for minor issues like loose hangers or small leaks.
